logisticsSettings.title: Algorithm Settings
logisticsSettings.subtitle: Tune the logistics batching algorithm

categories.scoringFormulaVars: N̂ = shipment count  ·  Û = urgency  ·  D̂ = route duration

MAX_VOLUME.label: Max volume per batch
MAX_VOLUME.explanation: The maximum capacity a driver's vehicle can carry in a single trip.

MAX_STOPS.label: Max stops per batch
MAX_STOPS.explanation: The maximum number of pickup or drop-off stops in a single batch.

MIN_BATCH_THRESHOLD.label: Minimum batch size
MIN_BATCH_THRESHOLD.explanation: The minimum number of shipments required to send a batch. If fewer, it's deferred to the next cycle.

CYCLE_INTERVAL_MINUTES.label: Grouping cycle interval
CYCLE_INTERVAL_MINUTES.explanation: How often the grouping cycle runs and batches available shipments.

MAX_FLOW_WAITING_MINUTES.label: Max flow waiting time
MAX_FLOW_WAITING_MINUTES.explanation: If flow shipments wait longer than this, the batch is force-sent regardless of size.

MAX_DISTANCE_KM.label: Max distance between zones
MAX_DISTANCE_KM.explanation: The maximum allowed distance between two zones on the same route.

W_N.label: Shipment count weight (W_n)
W_N.explanation: The impact of shipment count on batch scoring. Higher = a larger count raises priority more.

W_U.label: Urgency weight (W_u)
W_U.explanation: The impact of urgency on batch ordering. Higher = the most urgent is sent first.

W_D.label: Route duration weight (W_d)
W_D.explanation: Penalty for long routes. Higher = longer routes are deprioritized more.

BASE_PENALTY.label: Dead-end penalty
BASE_PENALTY.explanation: The penalty subtracted from a batch's score when there's no order in the destination zone. penalty = BASE_PENALTY × (1 − Û)

COST_PER_KM.label: Cost per kilometer
COST_PER_KM.explanation: The calculated cost per kilometer. Used to compare extending a route vs. dispatching a new driver.

ROAD_FACTOR.label: Distance adjustment factor
ROAD_FACTOR.explanation: The ratio of actual road distance to straight-line distance. Compensates for turns and bends.

INTRA_CITY_MIN_TIME_BUFFER_MINUTES.label: Min time buffer for mid-trip addition
INTRA_CITY_MIN_TIME_BUFFER_MINUTES.explanation: The minimum time remaining to reach zone B before new shipments can be added mid-trip.

DRIVERS_PER_ROUND.label: Drivers per round
DRIVERS_PER_ROUND.explanation: The number of drivers notified of a batch in each assignment round.

MAX_ASSIGNMENT_ROUNDS.label: Max assignment rounds
MAX_ASSIGNMENT_ROUNDS.explanation: If all drivers decline or time out in every round, the batch is escalated to a supervisor.

ASSIGNMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.label: Driver acceptance timeout
ASSIGNMENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.explanation: How long the system waits for a driver to accept in each round before moving to the next.
